2322010.title: God of War Ragnarok
2322010.summary: Turn Steam Input on: PlayStation buttons through Steam Input, rumble on the haptic actuators through an Xbox controller, R2 heavier along the pull while L2 aims, L2 vibrating
2322010.summary_zh: 请开启 Steam Input：经由 Steam Input 显示 PlayStation 按键，震动通过 Xbox 控制器交给触觉致动器，按住 L2 瞄准时 R2 越按越重，L2 持续振动
2322010.measured: 2026-10-16, pr90.24: under Wine the game skips the PlayStation PC SDK and never vibrates through Steam Input. With Steam Input on it reads the controls and shows PlayStation buttons through Steam Input, and sends its rumble to the XInput pad (755 commands, 1,069 haptic reports, no errors). R2's slope followed L2 (28 presses and releases), L2 vibrated throughout, both released at exit; the user felt both. Controls did not double.
